author: Screen Junkies
description:
Tickets for Power Ballad starring Paul Rudd and Nick Jonas are available now at www.powerballad.movie, and we got to sit down with those two + writer/director John Carney for a wide ranging interview about the next Ant Man villain, Paul Rudd’s mean guy reputation, and justice for bass players

#powerballad #paulrudd #nickjonas #interview
title: Honest Interview: Paul Rudd (Ft. Nick Jonas)
